relationships.subject: PGDHC
relationships.evidence_quote: pretreatment with either 1 μg/mL PEDHC or 1 μg/mL PGDHC significantly potentiated the capsaicin-stimulated currents in TRPV1-HEK cells held at −60 mV

relationships.subject: PEDHC
relationships.evidence_quote: pretreatment with PEDHC (10 μg/mL) significantly potentiated capsaicin-induced Ca2+ influx in TRPV1-HEK cells compared to PBS-pretreated TRPV1-HEK cells

relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: LPS-PG pretreatment did not significantly alter capsaicin-induced intracellular Ca2+ increases in TRPV1-HEK cells compared to PBS-pretreated TRPV1-HEK cells at all tested concentrations

key_findings: Bacteroidetes-derived dihydroceramides PEDHC and PGDHC sensitize TRPV1 to capsaicin in a concentration-dependent manner in HEK cells; neither activates TRPV1 alone
P. gingivalis LPS did not significantly affect TRPV1 activity in TLR4-lacking HEK cells
